name: vnpay-local-sandbox-guard
title: Chặn cổng thanh toán production khi chạy local
description: Đảm bảo môi trường development/local luôn tạo giao dịch MoMo/VNPAY sandbox dù cấu hình nhà hàng còn lưu production, trừ khi có opt-in rõ ràng.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The shared PaymentSession pre-save boundary now forces sandbox outside NODE_ENV=production unless PAYMENT_ALLOW_PRODUCTION_IN_DEVELOPMENT=true. Historical callback verification is unchanged. Vite ECONNABORTED remains a transient Socket.IO disconnect and does not affect payUrl generation. Focused tests and node --check were not executed because the GitHub connector does not provide a dependency checkout.
